title: DirectorySync
subtitle: Directory and drive synchronization tool with safe sync handling
description: A file synchronization application that combines Directory Sync and Drive Sync into one application.
It supports multi-directory sync groups and known-drive-to-folder sync pairs, with preview mode, conflict preservation, archive-safe deletes, configurable filters, and license-controlled features.
Demo note: Both demo videos were recorded before Drive Sync and Directory Sync were merged. The current UI looks slightly different, but the applications work and look mostly the same.
features: Create and manage named directory sync groups
Add and remove directory paths from each group
Preview and synchronize all directories in a selected group
Detect connected drives and identify known drives using stable drive identifiers
Create sync pairs between known drives and local folder paths
Preview and synchronize configured drive and folder pairs
Preserve conflicts instead of automatically overwriting user changes
Archive deleted files instead of permanently removing them by default
Use configurable filters to skip OS-managed folders and internal sync data
Preserve supported timestamps, permissions, and file attributes
Use integrated Directory Sync and Drive Sync interfaces from one application
Activate Directory, Drive, or Pro licensing from the integrated License tab
Use Pro drive monitoring and automatic synchronization for configured drives
View application logs and sync status

downloadLinks.title: Product Listing
downloadLinks.body: Combined directory and drive synchronization utility with preview mode, conflict protection, archive-safe deletes, configurable filters, and licensing.

howItWorks: DirectorySync combines Directory Sync and Drive Sync inside one application.
Directory Sync organizes multiple folder paths into named groups that should contain the same synchronized files.
Drive Sync detects connected drives, saves known-drive identities, and connects a known drive with a selected local folder using sync pairs.
Both synchronization systems support previewing changes before they are applied and use safe conflict and delete handling.
Licensing controls access to Directory Sync, Drive Sync, and supported Pro functionality.
setupInstall: Open the License tab and activate the appropriate Directory, Drive, or Pro license
For Directory Sync, create a group and add the folder paths that should be synchronized
For Drive Sync, scan connected drives, save the desired known drive, and create a drive-to-folder sync pair
Use Preview to review planned changes before running Sync
apiStructure: The main DirectorySync application provides the shared application shell, licensing, version display, and access to Directory Sync and Drive Sync.
Directory Sync manages named directory groups and their participating paths.
Drive Sync manages drive detection, known drives, drive-to-folder sync pairs, settings, monitoring, and event-driven synchronization.
DirSync performs directory comparison, synchronization, conflict handling, archive handling, and filtering.

commonQuestions.question: Are DirectorySync and DriveSync still separate applications?
commonQuestions.answer: No. DriveSync is now integrated into DirectorySync. Directory Sync and Drive Sync are available from the same application based on the active license.

commonQuestions.question: What is a directory group?
commonQuestions.answer: A directory group is a named set of folders that DirectorySync keeps aligned with each other.

commonQuestions.question: Does Drive Sync rely on drive letters?
commonQuestions.answer: No. Drive Sync uses drive identification logic so configured drives can be recognized more reliably than by drive letter alone.

commonQuestions.question: Should I preview before syncing?
commonQuestions.answer: Yes. Preview mode lets you review planned synchronization actions before files are changed.

commonQuestions.question: What happens when synchronized copies of the same file conflict?
commonQuestions.answer: DirectorySync preserves conflicting versions for manual resolution instead of silently choosing one version.

commonQuestions.question: Does DirectorySync permanently delete files?
commonQuestions.answer: When archive delete handling is enabled, deleted files are archived instead of being immediately permanently removed.

commonQuestions.question: What does a Pro license provide?
commonQuestions.answer: Pro provides access to both Directory Sync and Drive Sync and enables supported Pro functionality such as drive monitoring and automatic synchronization.
